text: I am kindly asking for your support of my motion to authorize an all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Kendal Avenue and Bridgman Ave and Macpherson Avenue. Continuous concerns have been raised by residents regarding the pedestrian safety at the intersection of Kendal Avenue and Bridgman Avenue and Macpherson Avenue, where there are a higher volume of pedestrians crossing east-west at this intersection travelling to/from the Dupont subway station and the George Brown College – Casa Loma Campus without a designated crosswalk across Kendal Avenue. The installation of an all-way stop at this intersection will enable the implementation of this desired east-west crosswalk connection and improve the overall safety at this intersection.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Kendal Avenue and Bridgman Avenue and Macpherson Avenue.
